$comment: Source of truth for SHA-pinned third-party agent plugins. Harness adapters (Claude Code marketplace, Cursor Cloud installer, …) materialize entries listed for that harness — they must not disagree with this file. Add a plugin here only when we intentionally freeze its commit; harness-native enables without a SHA (e.g. Nx from GitHub) stay out until we pin them.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core skills library: TDD, debugging, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques — pinned, because the Superpowers-First Workflow layers on behaviours Superpowers does not know it promises.
